about: GTA 6's 8 people (Delta, catalog Short, slug gta-cast). Every role line comes from Rockstar's own People pages at rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/<name> (read 2026-11-24, server-rendered text): Jason 'wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder'; Lucia 'Lucia's father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk'; Cal 'snooping on Coast Guard comms' while 'hanging at home'; Boobie 'all smiles until it's time to talk business'; Dre'Quan 'always more of a hustler than a gangster'; Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy) 'friends since high school', tagline 'Viral videos. Viral hooks.'; Raul 'a seasoned bank robber always on the hunt for talent'; Brian 'been around long enough to let others do his dirty work'. Order = Rockstar's People menu. GTA VI out Nov 19 2026 (rockstargames.com/VI). Sources in BRIEF.md.
